app.name: Azaria
app.offline: You are offline. Saved entries will sync when you reconnect.

install.title: Install app
install.hint: Put Azaria on your home screen so it opens like an app.
install.ios: On iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
install.browser: In Chrome, tap the browser menu, then Install app or Add to Home screen.

auth.intro: Record your sales and expenses every day, know your money, and see who owes you.
auth.resetSent: If that email exists, a reset link is on its way.
auth.checkEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.alreadyRegistered: This email already has an account. Tap Sign in below. If you forgot your password, tap Forgot password on the sign-in screen.
auth.linkExpired: That link is too old or was already used. Enter your email to get a new one.

emailConfirm.title: Confirm your email
emailConfirm.why: If you forget your password, we send the way back in to your email. Confirm it now so that works.
emailConfirm.sendTo: We will send a code to
emailConfirm.typeCode: Type it here. It can take a minute to arrive. Look in spam too.
emailConfirm.wrongCode: That code is not right, or it is too old. Check it, or tap Send again.
emailConfirm.wait: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
emailConfirm.done: Your email is confirmed. Thank you.

onboarding.title: Set up your business
onboarding.intro: Just the basics. You can change these later.
onboarding.created: Your business is ready. Record your first sale!

business.none: You are not a member of any business yet.

sale.customerRequired: Choose a customer so you can track what they owe.
sale.savedOffline: Sale saved on this device. It will sync when you are online.

expense.savedOffline: Expense saved on this device. It will sync when you are online.

dashboard.noEntries: No entries yet. Add your first sale.
dashboard.profitNote: Sales minus spending is not your profit. Stock on hand, credit sales and owner money change the picture.

customers.title: Customers
customers.name: Name
customers.reminderText: Hello {name}, a friendly reminder that {amount} is outstanding at {business}. Thank you!
customers.phoneHint: Optional. Used for a WhatsApp reminder.
customers.duplicate: You already have a customer with this name.
customers.phoneInvalid: Enter a phone number using digits, spaces and + ( ) . - only.

reports.title: Reports
reports.notCounted: Moved between your accounts, not counted

sync.title: Sync status
sync.warning: Entries saved on this device can be lost if you clear browser data or lose the phone. Sync as soon as you are online.

members.title: People and phones
members.intro: Add a person and the phone they use. Staff record sales and expenses. Staff cannot undo an entry, invite an owner, or download the whole business. An admin can correct mistakes.
members.name: Person
members.empty: Only you so far. Add someone when another phone is used for the shop.

privacy.title: Privacy and data
privacy.body: People you add see this business. The Azaria support team can also open it to help you; each time they do is listed below. Download a copy from Settings. A sale or expense saved on this phone stays on this phone until it syncs.

sale.title: Add a sale
sale.body: Enter what the customer bought and how much you received. If they still owe you, pick their name so the debt is tracked.

expense.title: Add an expense
expense.body: Everyday costs such as rent and transport are expenses. Goods you bought to sell are stock purchases, kept separate.

debt.title: Customer owes
debt.body: A later payment reduces what they owe. It is not another sale.

move.title: Move money
move.body: Moving cash to Mobile Money changes the two accounts and does not change your sales.

reverse.title: Fix a mistake
reverse.body: An owner or manager can reverse an entry. The original stays, marked reversed, and the money is put back.

paper.title: Invoice and receipt
paper.body: An invoice is a bill for a customer. A receipt shows money received. Download either as a PDF. Neither one adds a second sale.

documents.title: Invoice or receipt
documents.invoiceIntro: This records the sale and makes a bill you can download as a PDF. It is not a second sale.
documents.receiptIntro: A receipt shows money received. Paid now records that sale as paid in full. Or pick an entry already in the daybook.
documents.customerRequired: Choose a customer. An invoice needs a name.
documents.savedOffline: Saved on this phone. The PDF is ready once you are online and the entry has synced.
documents.noneToReceipt: No sale or payment here yet.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.AZ_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.AZ_INVALID_INPUT: Some of the details are not valid. Please check and try again.
errors.AZ_CONTACT_REQUIRED: Choose a customer for a credit sale.
errors.AZ_EXCEEDS_DEBT: The payment is more than what the customer owes.
errors.AZ_NOT_FOUND: We could not find that record.
errors.AZ_NO_MONEY_RECEIVED: There is no money received on this entry, so there is no receipt.
errors.AZ_SUPPORT_NOT_GRANTED: The owner has not given support access to this shop, or it has ended.
errors.AZ_TRIAL_USED: This shop has already used its free trial.
errors.AZ_DISCOUNT_INVALID: This code is not valid, or it has run out.
errors.AZ_DISCOUNT_EXISTS: That code already exists. Choose another.
errors.AZ_PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE: Payment is not available right now. Please try again in a moment.

add.saleHint: Cash, Mobile Money or on credit
add.expenseHint: Running costs, or goods you bought to sell
add.paymentHint: A customer pays what they owe
add.transferHint: Between cash, Mobile Money and bank
add.ownerHint: Your own money in or out of the business
add.invoiceHint: A bill for a customer, as a PDF
add.receiptHint: Proof of money received, as a PDF

owner.title: Owner money
owner.in: I put my own money into the business
owner.out: I took money out for myself
owner.hint: Owner money is not a sale and not an expense.

support.reason: Reason (the owner can be told this)
support.reasonNeeded: Give a reason of at least three letters.
support.viewing: Support view of {name}. You can only look.
support.ownerIntro: The Azaria support team can open this shop to help you. Some team members can only look. Some can also add or correct entries, and those are saved under their name, not yours. Each time support opens your shop it is listed here.

events.viewed: Support opened this shop to look
events.edit_opened: Support opened this shop to make changes

support.discountsIntro: Make a code to give someone money off Azaria Plus. The code works for a set time or for ever. A 100% code turns Plus on with nothing to pay.
support.discountMaxUses: Most payments that may use it
support.discountInvalid: Check the code, the percent and the limit.
support.paymentsOnHelp: Every shop is asked to pay for Azaria Plus. A shop that has not paid does not have Plus.
support.paymentsOffHelp: Nobody is asked to pay. Every shop uses everything for free, and no shop uses up its free trial.
support.paymentsConfirmOn: Every shop will be asked to pay from now. Shops that have not paid lose Azaria Plus at once. Bookkeeping stays free.
support.paymentsConfirmOff: Nobody will be able to pay, and every shop gets everything for free. Time that shops already paid for keeps running.
support.plansHelp: A new price applies to the next payment. Time already paid for does not change.
support.editing: You are working in {name} as support. What you add or change is saved in this shop under your own name.
support.adminsIntro: Add the people who support shops, and choose what each one may do. A change works at once.
support.adminEmailHint: They must already have an Azaria account with this email.
support.adminNotFound: No account has this email. Ask the person to sign up first.
support.adminSuper: Superadmin: everything, and manages the team
support.adminSelf: You are a superadmin. Another superadmin must change or remove your entry.

rights.edit_shops: Add or change anything in shops

about.shops: Find a shop to help. Each time you open a shop it is recorded, and the owner can see it.
about.accounts: Everyone who has signed up, with or without a shop.
about.discounts: Codes that take money off Azaria Plus.
about.payments: Turn payments on or off for everyone, and set the prices.
about.admins: Who is on the support team and what each person may do.

guide.title: Guides
guide.userHint: Everything you can do in Azaria, step by step
guide.adminHint: For owners and admins: people, corrections, data and support access
guide.loadError: The guide could not be opened. Check your connection and try again.
guide.englishOnly: This guide is in English for now.

about.title: About Azaria
about.hint: The story behind the app and what it stands for

plus.title: Azaria Plus
plus.intro: Azaria Plus adds extra help on top of your bookkeeping. Recording sales, expenses and debts stays free, with or without Plus.
plus.graceUntil: Your Plus time ended on {date}. Plus stays on for a few more days. Pay now to keep it.
plus.off: Plus is not on for this shop.
plus.codeHint: If someone from Azaria gave you a code, type it here.
plus.payFree: Turn on Plus, nothing to pay
plus.payHint: You pay on Paystack's page with Mobile Money or a card, then you come back here.
plus.privacy: Paystack receives your email address and the payment. It does not receive your records.
plus.ownerOnly: Only the shop owner can pay for Plus.
plus.returnPaid: Payment received. Plus is on until {date}.
plus.returnPending: We have not received the payment yet. If you approved it on your phone, wait a moment and check again.
plus.returnFailed: The payment did not go through. You can try again.
plus.returnUnknown: We could not find this payment.
plus.freeForNow: Azaria is free for now. You do not need to pay, and everything is open to your shop.
plus.freeForNowLater: When payment starts, you will see the prices here first.
